cards.example_en: We play soccer in the park every Saturday morning.
cards.example_zh: 我们每周六早上都在公园踢足球。
cards.explain_zh: 英式英语通常称football，美式称soccer。

cards.example_en: We play soccer in the park every Saturday morning.
cards.example_zh: 我们每周六早上都在公园踢足球。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We turned the heating on when the evening grew chilly.
cards.example_zh: 傍晚天凉起来时，我们打开了暖气。
cards.explain_zh: 指供暖时通常不可数：turn on the heating。

cards.example_en: We listened to a recording of birds during breakfast.
cards.example_zh: 早餐时，我们听了一段鸟鸣录音。
cards.explain_zh: 一段录音可数；表示录制过程时通常不可数。

cards.example_en: We asked for a non-smoking room at reception.
cards.example_zh: 我们在前台要求安排一间无烟客房。
cards.explain_zh: 可指场所禁烟，也可指人不吸烟。

cards.example_en: We asked for a non-smoking room at reception.
cards.example_zh: 我们在前台要求安排一间无烟客房。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Please include your postcode when you fill in the form.
cards.example_zh: 填写表格时，请填上你的邮政编码。
cards.explain_zh: 英式常用postcode；美式常用ZIP code。

cards.example_en: Her blonde hair shone brightly in the afternoon sun.
cards.example_zh: 她的金发在午后的阳光下闪闪发亮。
cards.explain_zh: blonde多用于女性；描述男性通常用blond。

cards.example_en: Her blonde hair shone brightly in the afternoon sun.
cards.example_zh: 她的金发在午后的阳光下闪闪发亮。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: A small stone got stuck inside my sandal.
cards.example_zh: 一颗小石子卡进了我的凉鞋里。
cards.explain_zh: 单只用sandal，一双用a pair of sandals。

cards.example_en: A duck paddled past us with several tiny ducklings.
cards.example_zh: 一只鸭子带着几只小鸭从我们身旁游过。
cards.explain_zh: 指鸭子时可数，指鸭肉时不可数。

cards.example_en: We carried the heavy suitcase up the narrow stairs.
cards.example_zh: 我们把沉重的行李箱沿着狭窄的楼梯搬了上去。
cards.explain_zh: stairs是复数，谓语用复数；一段楼梯用a flight of stairs。

cards.example_en: Could I have a vegetable sandwich to take away?
cards.example_zh: 请给我一个蔬菜三明治打包带走，好吗？
cards.explain_zh: take away是动词短语；外卖餐名词写takeaway。

cards.example_en: She offered each guest a small piece of candy.
cards.example_zh: 她给每位客人递了一小块糖果。
cards.explain_zh: 美式常用candy，英式常用sweets；一块用a piece of。

cards.example_en: Keep your boarding card handy until you reach your seat.
cards.example_zh: 到座位之前，把登机牌放在方便拿取的地方。
cards.explain_zh: 指登机牌，不是机票；boarding pass也很常用。

cards.example_en: Please put your rubbish in the bin outside.
cards.example_zh: 请把垃圾放进外面的垃圾桶。
cards.explain_zh: 通常不可数；英式常用词，美式常说garbage或trash。

cards.example_en: Reducing household rubbish requires both convenient recycling facilities and greater public awareness of unnecessary packaging.
cards.example_zh: 减少生活垃圾既需要便利的回收设施，也需要提高公众对过度包装的认识。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I stopped at the restroom before boarding the bus.
cards.example_zh: 上公交车前，我去了一趟洗手间。
cards.explain_zh: 美式英语中指公共厕所，不是普通的休息室。

cards.example_en: Providing a clean public restroom near busy transport hubs improves comfort for commuters and tourists alike.
cards.example_zh: 在繁忙的交通枢纽附近提供干净的公共洗手间，能让通勤者和游客都更加舒适。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We stayed awake until midnight watching the snow fall.
cards.example_zh: 我们一直醒着看雪，直到午夜。
cards.explain_zh: 在午夜用at midnight，不用in midnight。

cards.example_en: We stayed awake until midnight watching the snow fall.
cards.example_zh: 我们一直醒着看雪，直到午夜。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Our cabin is in the northwest of the island.
cards.example_zh: 我们的小木屋位于岛的西北部。
cards.explain_zh: 西北风从西北吹来；向西北走用head northwest。

cards.example_en: Our cabin is in the northwest of the island.
cards.example_zh: 我们的小木屋位于岛的西北部。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: A runner in bright shoes passed us by the lake.
cards.example_zh: 一位穿着亮色鞋子的跑步者在湖边从我们身旁跑过。
cards.explain_zh: run加-er时双写n；runner-up指亚军。

cards.example_en: We cooked the pork slowly with apples and onions.
cards.example_zh: 我们把猪肉和苹果、洋葱一起慢炖。
cards.explain_zh: pork是不可数名词，指肉；活猪用pig。

cards.example_en: A tiny spider built a web beside our window.
cards.example_zh: 一只小蜘蛛在我们窗边结了网。
cards.explain_zh: 蜘蛛有八条腿，不属于六条腿的昆虫。

cards.example_en: Could you pass me the pepper for my soup?
cards.example_zh: 能把胡椒粉递给我，让我加到汤里吗？
cards.explain_zh: 胡椒粉不可数；指一个甜椒时可说a pepper。

cards.example_en: We are going camping by the river this weekend.
cards.example_zh: 这个周末我们要去河边露营。
cards.explain_zh: 活动名词camping不可数；去露营说go camping。

cards.example_en: An ant carried a crumb across the kitchen floor.
cards.example_zh: 一只蚂蚁叼着面包屑爬过厨房地板。
cards.explain_zh: ant是可数名词；一只蚂蚁用an ant。

cards.example_en: He flipped the pancake and reached for the honey.
cards.example_zh: 他把煎饼翻了个面，伸手去拿蜂蜜。
cards.explain_zh: 英式通常较薄，美式通常较厚且蓬松。

cards.example_en: The left headphone stopped working during the journey.
cards.example_zh: 旅途中，左侧耳机听筒停止了工作。
cards.explain_zh: 日常说耳机通常用复数headphones，一副用a pair of。

cards.example_en: This cotton shirt feels soft even after many washes.
cards.example_zh: 这件棉衬衫洗了很多次后摸起来仍然很柔软。
cards.explain_zh: 通常不可数；cotton shirt中cotton作名词定语。

cards.example_en: We bought a kilogramme of apples at the market.
cards.example_zh: 我们在市场买了一公斤苹果。
cards.explain_zh: 英式拼写变体；kilogram更常用，符号kg不加s。

cards.example_en: Chopping this onion is making my eyes water again.
cards.example_zh: 切这个洋葱又让我流眼泪了。
cards.explain_zh: 开头是元音音素，单数前用an：an onion。

cards.example_en: A small bakery has just opened in our neighbourhood.
cards.example_zh: 我们街区刚开了一家小面包店。
cards.explain_zh: 英式拼写为neighbourhood，美式为neighborhood。

cards.example_en: I felt sleepy after lunch and took a short nap.
cards.example_zh: 午饭后我觉得困，就小睡了一会儿。
cards.explain_zh: sleepy是想睡的；asleep是已经睡着的。

cards.example_en: Students who feel sleepy during lessons may struggle to concentrate and retain new information effectively.
cards.example_zh: 上课时感到困倦的学生可能难以集中注意力，也难以有效记住新知识。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We share the housework so nobody spends Sunday cleaning alone.
cards.example_zh: 我们分担家务，这样就没人需要独自在周日打扫了。
cards.explain_zh: 不可数，不能说a housework；做家务用do。

cards.example_en: We share the housework so nobody spends Sunday cleaning alone.
cards.example_zh: 我们分担家务，这样就没人需要独自在周日打扫了。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I use my tablet to watch cooking videos.
cards.example_zh: 我用平板电脑看烹饪视频。
cards.explain_zh: tablet既指平板电脑，也指药片，需看语境。

cards.example_en: My toothache kept me awake for most of the night.
cards.example_zh: 牙痛让我大半夜都没睡着。
cards.explain_zh: 英式常说have toothache，美式常说have a toothache。

cards.example_en: I tried snowboarding yesterday and landed in soft snow.
cards.example_zh: 昨天我尝试了单板滑雪，摔进了松软的雪里。
cards.explain_zh: snowboarding双脚固定在一块板上，区别于双板滑雪。

cards.example_en: Snowboarding lessons should include safety training so that beginners can share mountain slopes responsibly.
cards.example_zh: 单板滑雪课程应包含安全训练，让初学者能负责任地与他人共用山坡雪道。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We skate around the rink every Saturday afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 我们每周六下午都在溜冰场滑冰。
cards.explain_zh: 鞋子常用复数skates；go skating表示去滑冰。

cards.example_en: My neighbour speaks Portuguese with her family at home.
cards.example_zh: 我的邻居在家和家人说葡萄牙语。
cards.explain_zh: 首字母大写；单个葡萄牙人用a Portuguese person。

cards.example_en: She put on red lipstick before leaving the house.
cards.example_zh: 她出门前涂了红色口红。
cards.explain_zh: 物质义不可数；一管口红用a tube of lipstick。

cards.example_en: The soup is bubbling in a pot on the cooker.
cards.example_zh: 锅里的汤正在炉灶上咕嘟咕嘟地冒泡。
cards.explain_zh: 英式cooker指炉灶，美式常用stove；厨师是cook。

cards.example_en: Schools can teach children to bake simple foods as part of practical lessons about nutrition and independence.
cards.example_zh: 学校可以教孩子烘焙简单的食物，将其作为营养与独立生活实践课的一部分。
cards.explain_zh: bake常用于面包、蛋糕；烤肉通常用roast。

cards.example_en: The gardener planted bright flowers along our front path.
cards.example_zh: 园丁沿着我们门前的小路种下了鲜艳的花。
cards.explain_zh: 既可指职业园丁，也可指在自家种花种菜的爱好者。

cards.example_en: I put on my pyjamas and climbed into bed.
cards.example_zh: 我穿上睡衣裤，爬上了床。
cards.explain_zh: 用复数；一套用a pair of；美式拼pajamas。
